name: pebbo
description: The Pebbo agent plugin: find and inspect Pebbo marketplace listings, and with your permission like listings and post your own. Requires a Pebbo account.

plugins.name: pebbo-claude
plugins.description: Find and inspect public Pebbo marketplace listings and see who posted them, list a seller's other listings or a user's listings by @username, read your own listings and your liked listings, and with separate permission like listings or post, edit, mark sold and delete your own and hand you a link to add photos. Requires a Pebbo account.
